Appendix 1 – Housing Trajectory and 5 Year Land Supply 2024/25 is listed as an accompanying decision document.

The current Havering Local Development Scheme was approved in April 2025 and covers 2025-2027.
The SADPD Proposed Submission Version was submitted for Examination on 31 October 2024.
On 6 November 2025 the Main Modifications consultation had closed and representations had been submitted to the Inspector.
The proposed Main Modifications consultation ran from 1 September to 27 October 2025.
On 22 July 2025 the Inspector produced a Post-Hearings Letter and accompanying schedule.
On 12 May 2025 the council published the reasonable-alternatives paper SUP 15 at the Inspector's request.
On 30 April 2025 the council published the Streatham CPZ information document SUP 14 for Proposed Site 3.
The SADPD examination hearings concluded on 6 March 2025.
The current new Lambeth Local Plan timetable lists a scoping consultation beginning 1 September 2026.
The current new Lambeth Local Plan timetable lists submission for Examination on 30 November 2028.
